name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
title: Eveready Industries India Ltd - 531508 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Eveready closed FY26 with 8.2% revenue and 8.9% EBITDA growth at 11.5% margin, but zinc inflation and a new INR200 crore Jammu alkaline plant (5-6 year payback) add supply and margin risk; management guides to similar margins.

capex.quote: With an investment of approximately INR200 crores, the facility has a peak capacity of up to 360 million alkaline batteries annually

triggers.label: Jammu plant INR200 cr, 360m units peak
triggers.quote: the facility has a peak capacity of up to 360 million alkaline batteries annually

triggers.label: Calibrated price hikes on zinc cost
triggers.quote: we undertook calibrated pricing actions in carbon zinc and alkaline batteries

triggers.label: BIS mandate may squeeze unbranded imports
triggers.quote: The recent mandate of a BIS standard mark being made mandatory for the flashlight category augurs well for us

triggers.label: Margin held near 11.5%, not expanded
triggers.quote: we should be able to hold around the same region

triggers.label: Debt cut by over INR100 cr
triggers.quote: having reduced debt by more than INR100 crores in the current fiscal year

guidance.quote: we are looking towards maintaining similar kinds as last year
we should be looking at exiting with 20% share

guidance.value: production of more than 100 million units in first year
guidance.quote: We expect production of more than 100 million units in the first year of operations
we continue the journey of further debt reduction in FY '27

red_flags.label: Zinc cost spike; margin held only by pricing
red_flags.quote: zinc prices witnessing a steep and sustained increase

red_flags.label: Non-exec director fee continuing despite new ED role
red_flags.quote: At this point of time, the payment is going on

red_flags.label: Tax rate transition and unclear carry-forward
red_flags.quote: Subject to utilization of the carryforward business loss.

evasions.quote: So I can't commit at this point of time. At this point of time, the payment is going on.
